text:
emma-docs: Drafting relnotes for the routing fallback change: requests will now automatically prefer quantized variants when Dedicated capacity is constrained. Putting snippets and a short migration checklist here for review before I open the PR.

raghav-eng: thanks. include explicit example of policy YAML and the behavior table (fallback order, latency/cost tradeoffs). Also note this affects token accounting for per-route dashboards.

lena-product: product asks: call out which customer tiers are affected and the canary timeframe. We'll want a short paragraph for the What's New page and a separate line in Known Issues about slight model output variance.

pat-sdk: SDK examples please. Show both REST and JS SDK usage and a small note how to opt out (policy: allow_fallback: false).

emma-docs: adding snippets. REST policy example:
```yaml
# routing policy: prefer quantized fallback
route: my-model-route
policy:
  primary: model-full-1
  fallbacks:
    - model-quant-1
    - model-compat-1
  allow_fallback: true
```

pat-sdk: JS SDK snippet to pin behavior:
```js
await client.routes.update('my-model-route', {
  policy: { primary: 'model-full-1', fallbacks: ['model-quant-1'], allowFallback: true }
});
```

raghav-eng: runtime note: quantized fallback reduces memory and usually adds ~6-10% latency on cold-starts but drops cost by ~18% token-equivalent. Add perf stat and link to infra benchmark. Also add a rollback paragraph: how to pin primary or disable fallback via allow_fallback: false.

lena-product: Known issue: small semantic diffs observed on ~0.2% of test prompts; include a short remediation section recommending a regression test set and how to pin exact model versions during rollout. Also mention Dedicated canary: 2% of customers on canary pool until next Mon.

emma-docs: noted. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7345 (includes policy examples, SDK snippets, perf note, known-issues, and product blurb).

deploy-bot: emma-docs pushed branch emma/routing-fallback -> staging/docs (CI: failing: linkcheck) :x:

emma-docs: failing linkcheck on the model catalog anchor. Pat, can you confirm the catalog anchor is `#quantized-models`? Support reported broken link under ticket #8124.

pat-sdk: confirming anchor changed in the last catalog restructure; will add a redirect in the PR. Also adding a short sed migration command to update references in repos: `git grep -l "allow_fallback" | xargs sed -i 's/allow_fallback/allowFallback/g'`.

raghav-eng: quick runtime addendum: pin runtime >= v1.6.0 for stable fallback headers. Add that to compatibility table.

lena-product: once published, marketing will add a banner for Dedicated customers and Support will get a template to proactively contact customers with >500 sustained concurrent connections.

emma-docs: thanks everyone. I'll fix linkcheck, add the redirect, and re-run CI. Scheduling relnote publish for Wed 08:30 PT if green. Closing thread for now; will post the publish timestamp when live.
